rules.fix: Define role/tenant-aware USING and WITH CHECK expressions for the actual identity model; review permissive-policy combinations and bypass roles.
rules.check: Two runtime identities cannot read/change each other's rows; inserts and updates enforce the intended owner and valid operations work.
rules.reason: Review signal: RLS policy has an unconditional expression. A match is not proof of exploitability; validate the actual service contract.
rules.detection: Regex with lexical exclusions: USING(true) or WITH CHECK(true). May be intentional and does not associate expressions with CREATE POLICY, roles or commands; effective policies and application authorization require review.
rules.limitations: Regex with lexical exclusions: USING(true) or WITH CHECK(true). May be intentional and does not associate expressions with CREATE POLICY, roles or commands; effective policies and application authorization require review.

rules.title: Template block disables autoescaping
rules.fix: Retain autoescaping for untrusted text; sanitize supported HTML explicitly and review the output context.
rules.check: User tags/attributes remain data and allowed formatting still works.
rules.reason: Review signal: Template block disables autoescaping. A match is not proof of exploitability; validate the actual service contract.
rules.detection: Regex excluding HTML/Jinja comments: Jinja/Twig autoescape false and Django autoescape off blocks. Does not evaluate template engine defaults, enclosing blocks or whether values are trusted.

rules.title: Credential-like value passed directly to console
rules.fix: Log stable event categories and approved identifiers, not credential values. Inspect failed-login and exception paths; implement and test any redaction helper independently.
rules.check: Synthetic canary credentials never appear in stdout, logs, exported evidence or screen broadcasts; failure categories remain useful.
rules.reason: Review signal: a credential-like value is logged directly. This does not prove that the value is a real secret.
rules.detection: Bounded JS tokens: console log/info/warn/error/debug/trace with direct sensitive names/properties, inline object/array values or concatenation. Observed console shadows/reassignments suppress hints file-wide. Templates, helper calls, custom loggers, dynamic keys and cross-file flows remain manual; absence of a signal does not verify redaction.
rules.limitations: Bounded JS tokens: console log/info/warn/error/debug/trace with direct sensitive names/properties, inline object/array values or concatenation. Observed console shadows/reassignments suppress hints file-wide. rules.title: PostgreSQL server file/program role granted
rules.after: GRANT SELECT ON notes TO app;
rules.fix: Separate application and administrator roles. Grant only required object privileges, not server file/program access; review memberships and revoke only approved service-owned grants with rollback.
rules.check: The actual runtime role cannot read/write server files or execute server programs; ordinary queries, migrations and recovery still work.
rules.reason: Review signal: an elevated PostgreSQL server role is granted. Review the recipient and its actual runtime privileges.
rules.detection: Bounded SQL: unquoted GRANT role lists containing pg_read_server_files, pg_write_server_files or pg_execute_server_program before TO. Comments/strings excluded; REVOKE and pg_monitor alone do not signal. Quoted roles, inheritance, later revocations, versions and effective permissions remain manual.
rules.limitations: Bounded SQL: unquoted GRANT role lists containing pg_read_server_files, pg_write_server_files or pg_execute_server_program before TO. Comments/strings excluded; REVOKE and pg_monitor alone do not signal. Quoted roles, inheritance, later revocations, versions and effective permissions remain manual.
